scope: Uploads that place server-executable content (script files, double-extension or content-type-mismatched files, handler-override configs) where the server can execute it.
label_rule: Deciding evidence: storage_path_policy and upload_handler purpose. Legitimate: the same script-looking file uploaded to a developer feature (code review, repository browser, snippet store, CI artifact) that stores it outside the web root, never executes it and serves it as text or download.
